svg.title: sbar — live stats, same terminal
svg.desc: Illustrative terminal demo: a command runs above a persistent status bar with updating CPU, memory, GPU, disk, and network metrics. Install with brew install funkydude755/tap/sbar. Supports macOS and Linux. The metrics and build output are examples.
svg.text: CPU, RAM, GPU, disk and network — right under your shell.
Your commands keep running. Your system stays in view.
Illustrative demo · example metrics and build output
